text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Durandal—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Durandal pointed,
there was a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes. I thought my family would really love something like this.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My younger sister started putting them up because she thought they were cute.
Then my older sister, and next my older brother...
and before long, they just kept multiplying."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because everyone in my family watches races, they naturally
started collecting them. I wonder if they'll be happy if I take this home.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it looks quite difficult to win.
I don't have much experience with this kind of game, so...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Durandal doesn't have much confidence. In that case—
choice_data_list: Could you leave it to me?
Could you leave it to me?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I look forward to working with you, my Lord!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
